fields.description: Unique id of this integration, e.g. crm-system.
fields.label: Connector Name

fields.description: What kind of ecosystem this talks to. system = signed-event business system. chat/mcp/a2a land in later slices.
fields.label: Modality

fields.description: Whether Friday receives from, sends to, or both.
fields.label: Direction

fields.description: Master switch. When off, inbound intake rejects events and the outbound client refuses to send.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Dotted Python module that exposes this connector's inbound handlers as a HANDLERS dict (system modality). e.g. frappe.friday_core.surfaces.randompack
fields.label: Handler Module

fields.description: Base URL of the external system, e.g. https://ops.example.com
fields.label: API Base URL

fields.description: API key for token auth (token key:secret).
fields.label: API Key

fields.description: API secret — stored encrypted at rest, never in code or git.
fields.label: API Secret
Outbound Signing Secret
fields.description: When set, every outbound JSON call carries X-Friday-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=HMAC_SHA256(secret, "t." + raw body) — the reverse-direction twin of Webhook Secret, proving to the external system that the caller is really Friday.
Shared HMAC secret for inbound signed events (X-RP-Signature style). Stored encrypted at rest.
fields.label: Webhook Secret

fields.description: Reject inbound signatures whose per-attempt timestamp `t` is older/newer than this many seconds.
fields.label: Signature Tolerance (seconds)

fields.description: Adapter-specific config (JSON). e.g. modality-typed options the thin adapter reads.
fields.label: Config
